name: The Bellringer
objective: The final battle of Quest Line 01: Director Krampus and his six-Pokémon team, capped by his signature Krampus Houndoom. At 50% HP he rings the Krampus Bell, granting his remaining Pokémon Winter's Wrath.
intro: The Krampus Bell hangs above the chamber, ancient and impossibly cold. The Director stands beneath it, waiting.
dialogue: Director Krampus: "Then you have chosen the easy path."
Director Krampus (at 50% HP): "You leave me no choice. Let the bell decide."
Director Krampus (defeated): "You think you've stopped us? You've only rung the first bell."

boss_mechanic.name: Krampus Bell
boss_mechanic.description: Every remaining enemy Pokémon receives a temporary battle effect: Attack up, Speed up, critical-hit chance up — but Defense down.

lore_discovery: The Winterheart begins to react. A massive roar echoes from beneath the fortress. Director Krampus escapes — the Krampus Bell was only one of several artifacts.
aftermath: The player receives their first major unique reward: the Krampus Houndoom.
